text.p: Rosenborg of Norway and Italy's Juventus drew 1-1 (halftime 0-0) in their European cup quarter-final first leg match on Wednesday.

Rosenborg - 1-Joern Jamtfall, 3-Erik Hoftun, 5-Staale Stensaas, 6-Roar Strand, 8-Bent Skammelsrud, 11-Mini Jakobsen, 14-Vegard Heggem, 15-Jon Olav Hjelde, 20-Trond Egil Soltvedt, 26-Sigurd Rushfeldt (10-Harald Brattbakk 68) 27-Andre Bergdoelmo (4-Bjorn Otto Bragstad 87).

Juventus - 1-Angelo Peruzzi, 3-Moreno Torricelli, 4-Paolo Montero, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 13-Mark Juliano, 7-Angelo Di Livio, 21-Zinedine Zidane, 14-Didier Deschamps (20-Alessio Tacchinardi 82), 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 11-Michele Padovano (16-Nicola Amoruso 61), 15-Christian Vieri.
